headline: 3 killed in Feni road accident, including a mother and daughter
summary: A collision between an auto-rickshaw and a pickup truck in Fulgazi, Feni, claimed three lives.
details: Three people, including a mother and her daughter, were killed in a road accident in Fulgazi, Feni.
The accident occurred when a pickup truck collided with an auto-rickshaw.
The victims were transported to the local hospital, where they were declared dead.
Local authorities are investigating the cause of the collision to determine responsibility.
caption:
A tragic collision in Feni has claimed three lives, including a mother and her daughter.

Three people, including a mother and her daughter, were killed in a road accident in Fulgazi, Feni.

The accident occurred when a pickup truck collided with an auto-rickshaw.

The victims were transported to the local hospital, where they were declared dead.

Local authorities are investigating the cause of the collision to determine responsibility.

headline_marked: Robbery suspect [[dies in police custody]] after mob beating in Adabar
headline: Robbery suspect dies in police custody after mob beating in Adabar
summary: A 38-year-old man, accused of looting Tk 40,000 and vandalizing a home, died while in custody after being beaten by a crowd.
details: Zahid, 38, died in police custody last night after sustaining injuries from a mob beating during an attempted robbery in Adabar’s Shyamoli Housing area.
Police report that Zahid entered a home in Farm Goli on Saturday afternoon armed with two machetes, vandalized furniture, and looted Tk 40,000 before being caught and beaten by locals.
Following the incident, police rescued Zahid and took him to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital for treatment before formally arresting him in a robbery case.
Zahid later fell ill again before being placed in the court lock-up and was rushed to National Medical College Hospital, where he was declared dead.
Police officials stated that Zahid was a known drug addict with a history of attacking locals and had several previous cases filed against him.
In a separate development, the deceased's mother had filed a general diary (GD) against him just yesterday for allegedly throwing her out of the house.
caption:
A robbery suspect died in police custody after being beaten by a mob in Adabar.

Zahid, 38, died in police custody last night after sustaining injuries from a mob beating during an attempted robbery in Adabar’s Shyamoli Housing area.

Police report that Zahid entered a home in Farm Goli on Saturday afternoon armed with two machetes, vandalized furniture, and looted Tk 40,000 before being caught and beaten by locals.

Following the incident, police rescued Zahid and took him to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital for treatment before formally arresting him in a robbery case.

Zahid later fell ill again before being placed in the court lock-up and was rushed to National Medical College Hospital, where he was declared dead.

Police officials stated that Zahid was a known drug addict with a history of attacking locals and had several previous cases filed against him.

In a separate development, the deceased's mother had filed a general diary (GD) against him just yesterday for allegedly throwing her out of the house.
